name: Fern Physio
short: A calm clinic site where patients tap where it hurts and book the next free slot.
long: Fern Physio opens on a bright treatment room and lets patients show where it hurts on a drawn body. Tap a knee or shoulder to see what that usually is, with the next three free slots one tap from booked. The first visit minute by minute, prices and the two physios follow.
proves: A visitor can say where it hurts before they have to say anything to a receptionist.
story: Clinics lose people at the phone call, because a sore shoulder is hard to describe to a stranger. Pointing at a drawing is not.
